tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the public Yutai registry for companies, the share classes each one carries and the token instruments listed for a share class. Answers one page at a time, with the link to the next page when more companies follow.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Read one company from the public Yutai registry by its legal name, with its share classes and token instruments. Give the two-letter country when two companies share a name.

tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: Read the facts of one or more token instruments by their instrument ids, including the programme behind each one, its legal form and any instrument the token converts into.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Read the chains Yutai's ledger covers, each with its tokenizers, stocks, supply and holder figures and the newest health reading beside them.

tools.name: list_tokenizers
tools.description: Read the tokenizer programmes Yutai's ledger covers, each with its issuer, its reach, its supply and its holder figures.

tools.name: get_market_activity
tools.description: Read one stock's public on-chain activity: its holder count, each token's supply by chain and tokenizer, and its recent large movements. Give a chain or a tokenizer to narrow the tokens and the movements.

tools.name: get_benefit_availability
tools.description: Read the benefits the companies behind one or more token instruments offer in one market, each with what a holder must do to reach it, how it is delivered, and whether it is an illustrative example. Give one or more instrument ids and the two-letter country.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read how each of Yutai's data domains stands today, each with the plain sentence for its mode, beside the answer's version, the build and its instant.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Yutai developer docs and read the matching pages as short snippets, each with the page's own address. Give a word or a phrase; the answer names up to the number of pages you ask for, five by default.
